column1: # UP Torre: the line plan, line by line.
# Source: UP International, "TORRE Line Plan" (TORRE_Line_Plan.pdf, one page),
# Transcribed 2026-10-19 from the drawing: each line and the line it hangs
#   from. A parent that is not a line is where the cascade ends: a riser, or
#   the brake handle. The drawing does not say which riser the stabilo line
#   is fixed to, so it ends at "riser S"; STI-0 is drawn continuing STI.
# Two risers. The a and b anchors of one rib share a line (A1 carries a1 and
#   b1), and the d anchors hang with the c: there is no B or D main line.
